question: Who was the first Indian to circumnavigate the world solo, non-stop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhilash Tomy.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Commander Abhilash Tomy, aged 42, a retired Indian naval officer was the first Indian to circumnavigate non-stop the World solo without any stops in 2013.**
 
• President Pranab Mukherjee accorded a warm welcome to the Indian Navy's Lt Cdr Abhilash Tomy on his return from over **a 150-day voyage.**
 
• **He has sailed around 23,100 nautical miles, crossing the Indian, Southern, Pacific, and Atlantic Oceans.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manohar Prahlad Awati**

 
 
• ​Vice Admiral Manohar Prahlad Awati, was a **Flag Officer in the Indian Navy.**
 
• He last served as the Flag Officer Commanding-in-Chief Western Naval Command.
 
• During the **Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, **he was awarded the** Vir Chakra **for his command of the **Arnala-class anti-submarine corvette INS Kamorta.**
 
 
 
• **Dilip Donde​**
 
 
• ​Captain Dilip Donde is a** retired Indian Naval officer **
 
• He is the** first Indian to complete a solo, unassisted circumnavigation of the globe under sail.**
 
 
 
• **Ratnakar Dandeka​**
 
 
• ​Ratnakar Dandekar, is the **managing director of Aquarius Shipyard Pvt Ltd.**
 
• It is a** shipbuilding company** that has grown in size, and confidence since it created its** first ocean-faring boat.**
